name: Crushridge Warmongers
summary: In the Ruins of Alterac, Crushridge Warmongers face a fiercer hunt. Marshal Redpath of Southshore sends you after them to keep the ogres from Alliance lands.

sections.title: A Harder Lesson
sections.body: Marshal Redpath sends you into the Ruins of Alterac after Crushridge Bounty. He wants you to hunt down many Crushridge Warmongers and strike the Crushridge ogres hard. Redpath believes nothing else will teach the brutes to keep clear of Alliance territory.

faq.q: Who sends you after the Crushridge Warmongers?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath in Southshore sends you after the Crushridge Warmongers.
They are in the Ruins of Alterac, high in the mountains.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Redpath want the Warmongers cut down?
faq.answer: Redpath believes nothing else will teach the Crushridge ogres to stay away from Alliance lands.
It follows Crushridge Bounty, Redpath's first call to hunt the Crushridge ogres.
